title: Helpdesk Intake Routed
description: Creator-collab slice 6: the helpdesk routed an intake session to a target room + (optional) fleet node. Carries the parent intake_id, the suggested target room_id, the routing rationale (which intent matched which room capability), and the optional deep-link to the target room's surface. Emitted by pmoves-helpdesk-skill after the visitor accepts (or the helpdesk auto-routes). Consumed by nats_event_bus + dashboard to surface intake outcomes.

from_room_id.description: Room that did the routing (typically pmoves.room.helpdesk)

to_room_id.description: Target room the intake was routed to (e.g. creator-studio.room.collab, fordham.room.community)

to_node.description: Optional fleet node the room session was opened on (e.g. 'POWERFULMOVES', 'pmoves-z890')

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why this target was chosen (which intent matched which room capability)

intent_match.description: Structured intent match for debugging + persona-aware ranking

intents.description: Intents extracted from the visitor's question

matched_room_capabilities.description: Capabilities of the target room that matched the intents

score.description: Persona-aware ranking score (0..1) used to break ties when multiple rooms match

deep_link.description: Optional deep-link into the target room's surface (e.g. '/canvas/creator?from=helpdesk')
